span.p:
POST /api/v1/media/upload first,
ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN only,
paste the returned URLs into the body

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Leave the base64 data URI inside the Tiptap HTML.
TiptapHtmlProcessor hoists it to S3 during save,
with no role check of its own

Row saved, CREATE audit log written,
the whole news cache evicted

span.p:
Anonymous callers can read it now.
There is no draft, review or publish gate

span.p: Put it on the homepage carousel?

403 FORBIDDEN.
SUPER_ADMIN is rejected, there is no role hierarchy bean

featured true, featuredOrder stored,

No cache is evicted on this path
